description.value:
A Gold Saint does not stay down.

Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright.

You remain conscious with 1 Hit Point instead of falling. You are wounded 1, or your wounded value increases by 1, and you cannot use this feat again until you have rested.

This is a raw refusal to fall, not healing. If the hit would kill you outright — reducing you below the negative of your maximum Hit Points — Rise does not save you.
